name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B EXL3 3.5bpw HQ
description: TensorFold/exllamav3 EXL3 HQ quantization of NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B (88-layer hybrid mamba-attention-MoE with MTP; text arch remapped from the omni checkpoint, fp16 vision tower kept in-pack). Encoded -b 3.5 --hq (3.5bpw experts, 5bpw attention+dense, 16bpw head and embeddings). Verified on DGX Spark hardware.
